knowledge:
- key_parameters: ip=Initial parameter list generated by init.para ;; chr=Vector of chromosome names for each probe ;; pos=Vector of genomic positions for each probe ;; LRR=Vector of Log R Ratio values ;; BAF=Vector of B Allele Frequency values ;; pInfo=Parameter information list returned by read.parameter ;; sampleid=Character string identifying the sample ;; output.dir=Directory path where output files will be written
- alternatives: PennCNV (for germline CNV calling), QuantiSNP (for CNV calling using objective Bayes), VanillaICE (for HMM-based CNV calling in Bioconductor)
- when_to_use: Use when you have SNP array data (LRR and BAF) and want to simultaneously estimate copy number states and genotype/LOH calls, specifically distinguishing between germline variations (using genoCNV) and somatic aberrations in tumor samples (using genoCNA).
- pitfalls: High noise or genomic waves in LRR data can severely bias HMM state transitions; users should perform GC content wave correction prior to running genoCN. Incorrect initial parameter specifications in the parameter file can lead to local optima during the Baum-Welch estimation.

workflows.name: germline_cnv_calling
workflows.intent: Identify germline copy number variations (CNVs) and genotype calls from SNP array data.
input: snp_data.txt (Tab-delimited file containing chromosome, position, LRR, and BAF values for each probe)
cnv_parameter.txt (Text file containing initial parameter specifications for the CNV HMM)
workflows.stages: 1. Read the HMM parameter specifications using read.parameter ;; 2. Initialize the HMM parameters using init.para ;; 3. Run the HMM estimation and state calling using genoCNV
workflows.code:
library(genoCN)
data(snp_info)
data(snp_data)
pInfo <- read.parameter(system.file("extdata/para.txt", package="genoCN"), CNA=FALSE)
ip <- init.para(pInfo, sampleid="sample1", LRR=snp_data$LRR, BAF=snp_data$BAF, pos=snp_info$pos, chr=snp_info$chr)
genoCNV(ip, snp_info$chr, snp_info$pos, snp_data$LRR, snp_data$BAF, pInfo, sampleid="sample1", output.dir=tempdir())

workflows.name: somatic_cna_calling
workflows.intent: Identify somatic copy number aberrations (CNAs) and loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in tumor samples.
input: tumor_snp_data.txt (Tab-delimited file containing chromosome, position, LRR, and BAF values from a tumor sample)
cna_parameter.txt (Text file containing initial parameter specifications for the CNA HMM)
workflows.stages: 1. Read the somatic HMM parameter specifications using read.parameter with CNA=TRUE ;; 2. Initialize the somatic HMM parameters using init.para ;; 3. Run the somatic HMM estimation and state calling using genoCNA
workflows.code:
library(genoCN)
data(snp_info)
data(snp_data)
pInfo <- read.parameter(system.file("extdata/para.txt", package="genoCN"), CNA=TRUE)
ip <- init.para(pInfo, sampleid="tumor_sample1", LRR=snp_data$LRR, BAF=snp_data$BAF, pos=snp_info$pos, chr=snp_info$chr, CNA=TRUE)
genoCNA(ip, snp_info$chr, snp_info$pos, snp_data$LRR, snp_data$BAF, pInfo, sampleid="tumor_sample1", output.dir=tempdir())
